name: Regression with robust standard errors (Python)
description: OLS/WLS and canonical logistic/Poisson IRLS, HC0-HC3 and one-way CR0/CR1/CR1S/CR2 covariance, explicit Wald/t/normal tests and bread/meat; validated against R sandwich 3.1.3, clubSandwich 0.7.0 and lmtest 0.9.40.

inputs.name: X
inputs.format: finite full-rank n x p design matrix; include intercept explicitly

inputs.name: cluster
inputs.format: one-way nonmissing cluster labels for retained rows

inputs.name: target
inputs.format: positive diagonal working variance vector for CR2

outputs: coefficients, fitted values, residuals, information, leverage, model covariance
HC/CR covariance, normalized bread/meat, adjusted scores and CR2 adjustment matrices
coefficient tests and confidence intervals with explicit df
linear-contrast Wald chi-square/F tests with explicit df
